title: Cathay Selected Sexy Reskin 1.0.0
author: Dwjliel
description:
I've collated some X-rated Cathay reskins into my personal favourite combination.

Kudos and thanks to the great mods:

Sexiest Grand Cathay <https://www.nexusmods.com/totalwarwarhammer3/mods/50> -- Endos Cathay <https://www.nexusmods.com/totalwarwarhammer3/mods/323> -- Corrupted Cathay Roster <https://www.nexusmods.com/totalwarwarhammer3/mods/74> -- Warmaidens <https://www.nexusmods.com/totalwarwarhammer3/mods/22?>

Much of this mod is built on the excellent expansive Warmaidens <https://www.nexusmods.com/totalwarwarhammer3/mods/22?> and its file "Warmaidens Resource Pack", is a REQUIRED mod.

The other files are NOT required, but can be used 🙂

Load order should be automatically set, safe to add or remove at any time.

Changes:

-
Bhashiva becomes a human female, with a customised, slighty more fierce unit card and portrait.

-
Shugengan Lord & Alchemist, made nude - only tiny edits to warmaidens.

-
Gate Master becomes female (Female voice in battle only).

-
Artillery and sky junks and lanterns crewed by corrupted ladies, (no updated unit cards).

-
NanGau Grenadiers (no updated unit cards)

-
10 other units made sexy, including their unit cards. All depicted in the screenshots.

-
Any unit made all female have had their voices changed to match

-
No other units were changed, including ROR's.

At the bottom of this post, please find an entirely optional tiny mod !(X)_Cathay_Skin_Names.7z that renames 4 units:

-
Jade Warriors --> Jade Whorriors

-
Jade Warriors (Crossbows) --> Jade Whorrior Crossbows

-
Nangau Grenadiers --> Slag Throwers

-
Peasant Spearmen -- > Spear Sluts

Also a submod for Jade Halberds should you so wish.

Recommended mod on Steam to match unit card quality : 4k Unit Cards <https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2866534785>.
